An eventful month guide for customers
Readers usually want a clear answer

Companion Animal Travel Desk boarding guidance

I am sorry for any confusion our travelers may have faced. This article explains how we help pets and their companions prepare for boarding at Aurelia Skyways, and it is meant to be followed in a calm and orderly way.

Please keep your pet's travel papers ready and follow the instructions given by the desk team. We ask that carriers stay secure, clean, and suited to the animal throughout the journey. If a companion animal shows signs of distress, staff should be told at once so the next step can be arranged with care.

The welcome team will review the documents and direct the traveler through the boarding path. <<FACT F099>> Please continue to stand by for the next instruction once that review is complete. Our role is to reduce delays and protect the comfort of each animal while boarding is prepared.

If a change must be made to the transfer process, our desk will pass the matter onward through the proper channel. <<FACT F106>> I regret that this can feel slow, yet the sequence is necessary so that each case is handled correctly and without avoidable error. Travelers should keep the pet close and avoid separating from the carrier unless a staff member says otherwise.

We also ask travelers to remain attentive to the tone and pace of guidance at the gate. A calm approach helps the companion animal stay settled, and it helps the team confirm that all boarding details are in order. If more than one traveler is present with a pet, each person should wait for the same instruction before moving ahead.

For further help, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk and our staff will respond with the next available guidance.
